author: Channel 5 with Andrew Callaghan
description:
Thank you for all for helping us meet and exceed our GoFundMe goal by 204%. To sign up for our new streaming platform C5.NOW and support independent documentary filmmakers, go to https://c5.now or download our app on iOs or Smart TV. 

NOTE: While a monthly subscription is $5.55 on the browser, you may notice that when signing up through the App Store or Google Plus, it comes out to $7.99. This is NOT our doing, but the result of a premium surcharge added by the companies who own your phone. If you'd like to get around this, sign up on a web browser (https://c5.now) and just use that same login on your phone or smart TV, and the charge will be avoided.
title: Lawsuit Update
